commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Facundo Garces (Alaves) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
90+9' Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
90+7' 2 - 0 Carlos Espi (Levante) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and produces a low drive that goes into the middle of the goal.
90+4' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) receives a yellow card.
90+3' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Levante is cautioned for aggressive play.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Blanco leaves the pitch and Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) comes on.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Angel Perez is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
88' 1 - 0 Goal! Carlos Espi (Levante) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 1:0.
88' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
87' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Oriol Rey (Levante). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
86' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Francisco Maeso interrupts the game. One of the players from Levante won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Alaves have a free kick.
84' 3:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante.
82' The ball goes out of play and Levante have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Lucas Boye (Alaves) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
79' Luis Castro decides to make a substitution. Ivan Romero will be replaced by Karl Etta Eyong (Levante).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Losada (Levante) is coming onto the pitch as Kareem Tunde cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' The attendance for today's match is 17880.
77' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
75' Carlos Espi (Levante) is penalised for a foul. Francisco Maeso had a clear view and blows his whistle.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Ander Guevara (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Carles Alena.
71' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
71' It will be a corner kick for Levante.
71' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

70' Carlos Espi (Levante) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Levante win a corner kick.
69' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Paco Cortes is replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).
68' Levante have a corner.
66' Levante are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
63' That will be all from Toni Martinez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Facundo Garces (Alaves).
61' Carles Alena (Alaves) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
61' Victor Parada (Alaves) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
58' Luis Castro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oriol Rey (Levante) replacing Ugo Raghouber.
58' Luis Castro is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Carlos Alvarez suffers an injury and Carlos Espi (Levante) comes on.
53' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Toni Martinez (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
51' Paco Cortes (Levante) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
49' Now Levante have a corner.
48' Paco Cortes (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Levante are awarded a corner kick.
47' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' The ball rebounds to Dela (Levante) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
45' Levante work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

44' Ivan Romero (Levante) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera made a superb athletic save to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Levante are going to take it.
42' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
39' Carles Alena (Alaves) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
38' Paco Cortes (Levante) takes a short corner kick.
35' Carles Alena (Alaves) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

34' Mathew Ryan doesn't have to worry about that one. Pablo Ibanez puts a cross in towards Toni Martinez (Alaves), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
31' The game is interrupted now, Toni Martinez (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Jonny Otto plays a short lofted pass to Victor Parada (Alaves), whose header from the centre of the box drifts well past the left post.

26' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
23' Alaves get a corner.
23' A snap shot by Antonio Blanco (Alaves) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Mathew Ryan produces a good save to thwart him.

23' Mathew Ryan pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
23' Alaves will take a corner kick.
22' Toni Martinez (Alaves) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
22' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Victor Parada (Alaves) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
19' A corner kick by Levante is thwarted by the well prepared Antonio Sivera (Alaves).
15' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Alaves.

10' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Paco Cortes, but his first-time effort flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
9' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Levante was in an offside position.
8' Ivan Romero (Levante) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
7' Alaves hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

3' Toni Martinez (Alaves) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the left side of the target, but Mathew Ryan keeps the ball out.
2' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. A free kick is awarded to Alaves.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Alaves will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francisco Maeso.
